narrative: The shelf by one candle. A heavy grey cat lies along the tall book, back to the room, tail over the fore-edge. The shorter book beside it is clear. A folded packet rests at the edge of the desk, the writing turned in. The coffer at the bed's foot is shut, both locks dark. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Put the fold on the desk and did not open the coffer.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Lay on the chronicle, and not on the Chaucer.

entities.name: Holinshed's Chronicles
entities.context: In photo: Found Gib on Field's chronicle
